instruction: A candid documentary full shot captures an indoor motion capture studio with a red carpet floor, white walls, and a projector mounted on the ceiling. On the right side of the frame, the woman in a white patterned t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) steps forward, touching the cheek of the bearded man in a black polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) with her right hand. The man stands on the left in profile, facing right towards her. The room is illuminated by warm overhead artificial lights.
